create_signal_adapter: create a SignalAdapter instance to connect to a signal-cli HTTP daemon for sending and receiving Signal messages
connect_signal_daemon: connect to a signal-cli daemon and start an SSE listener for inbound Signal messages
send_text_message: send a text message to a Signal contact or group via the SignalAdapter.send method
send_image_attachment: send an image file or URL as a Signal attachment with an optional caption
get_chat_info: retrieve contact or group information for a Signal chat by phone number or group ID
